project.name: hoopR
project.description: SportsDataverse R package for mens college basketball and NBA play-by-play, schedule, roster, and stats data (ESPN + NBA Stats API).

nodes.name: pkgdown.yaml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds the hoopR pkgdown documentation site on pushes to main/master (or manual dispatch) and deploys it via pkgdown::deploy_to_branch, installing SportsDataverse companion packages and KenPom (KP_USER/KP_PW) credentials needed to render vignettes.
nodes.languageNotes: Single ubuntu-latest R-release job using r-lib/actions; concurrency group cancels in-progress runs; needs contents:write permission to push the built site.

nodes.name: R-CMD-check.yaml
nodes.summary: Primary CI workflow running R CMD check across a macOS/Windows/Ubuntu matrix (R release) on push, pull request, and a weekly Friday cron, with optional live-API test toggles (NBA Stats, NBA G-League, ESPN, NCAA MBB) supplied via secrets.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses r-lib/actions setup-r + check-r-package with upload-snapshots; live tests still short-circuit on skip_on_ci() unless the *_TESTS secrets enable them.

nodes.name: rhub.yaml
nodes.summary: Manually-dispatched R-hub v2 workflow that fans out R CMD check across user-selected R-hub platforms (linux containers + windows/macos) for CRAN-submission validation, with a setup job emitting the platform/container matrix consumed by the downstream check jobs.
nodes.languageNotes: Canonical r-hub/actions template: workflow_dispatch-only with a setup job whose JSON outputs drive matrix strategies; requires an RHUB_TOKEN plus the same KenPom + live-API secrets as the other workflows.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: AI/contributor development guide for hoopR documenting the package overview (270+ functions across nba_*/espn_*/kp_* families), branching/PR workflow, NBA Stats API function pattern, V2-vs-V3 differences, null-safety and return-value initialization conventions, the httr2 HTTP layer with proxy support, testing gates, and the NEWS/cran-comments/_pkgdown release triad.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Standard Contributor Covenant code of conduct defining community pledge, behavioral standards, enforcement responsibilities, scope, and a four-tier enforcement guideline (correction through permanent ban).

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contributor onboarding guide covering development setup, the devel-branch workflow, the step-by-step recipe for adding a new NBA Stats API endpoint, function naming conventions, roxygen documentation rules, testing gates with environment variables, CI/GitHub Actions, and commit-message standards.

nodes.name: LICENSE.md
nodes.summary: MIT license text for the hoopR package.

nodes.name: NEWS.md
nodes.summary: Full release changelog from v0.0.0.9 through v3.1.0, documenting new exported functions, behavior changes, deprecations, and internals per version — including the 3.1.0 cross-source crosswalks, Fox Sports / CBD / Torvik / Basketball-Reference / RealGM wrappers, and the 3.0.0 httr-to-httr2 and usethis-to-cli migrations.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project landing page (rendered from README.Rmd) with badges, installation instructions, quick-start examples for loading full NBA (2002-2026) and men's college basketball (2006-2026) play-by-play seasons, documentation links, breaking-change notes, authors, contributors, and citations.

nodes.name: _pkgdown.yml
nodes.summary: pkgdown site configuration for hoopR.sportsdataverse.org defining the Bootstrap template, navbar, authors, home metadata, and the full reference index grouping all exported functions by data-source family (hoopR loaders, crosswalks, ESPN, NBA Stats, NCAA, KenPom, CBD, Torvik, injury reports).

nodes.name: cran-comments.md
nodes.summary: CRAN submission notes for v3.1.0 summarizing the release themes (NBA schedule CDN migration, proxy-support regression fix, three-column @return table upgrade), per-source wrapper additions, R CMD check results, and revdepcheck results.

nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Git attributes file normalizing all text/source files to LF line endings cross-platform and marking binary asset types (png, rds, rda, qs) so they are never normalized.

nodes.name: copilot-instructions.md
nodes.summary: GitHub Copilot guidance for the hoopR package covering project context, repository workflow, code style, the httr2 HTTP/proxy layer, cli messaging, function naming, roxygen documentation, and testing conventions.

nodes.name: bug_report.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for reporting bugs in hoopR, prompting for the affected function/parameters, a reprex, expected behavior, error output, and session info.

nodes.name: feature_request.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for proposing a new function, endpoint, or improvement, with prompts for the desired solution, NBA Stats API endpoint details, and alternatives considered.

nodes.name: PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
nodes.summary: Pull request template structuring contributions with summary, type-of-change, related issues, changes made, submission/testing checklists, and reviewer checklist sections.

nodes.name: .Rbuildignore
nodes.summary: R CMD build ignore list excluding non-package files (data-raw, vignettes source, docs, CI config, CLAUDE.md, tooling, and dev artifacts) from the built tarball.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Scoping config for the understand-anything knowledge-graph indexer that keeps R source, data-raw generators, vignettes, and CI while excluding tests, generated man pages, bundled data, and binary artifacts.

nodes.name: gap_analysis.md
nodes.summary: Coverage gap analysis comparing the Python nba_api endpoints (146) against hoopR's nba_* exports (184), listing missing endpoints by priority, deprecation candidates, and hoopR-only extras.

nodes.name: get_exported_functions.R
nodes.summary: Developer data-prep script using pkgapi to map the package, extract exported function definitions and their parameters, and write CSV manifests of exported functions and nba_ stats parameters.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pkgapi::map_package() to introspect exports and self-calls across the package.

nodes.name: intro-to-hoopR.Rmd
nodes.summary: R Markdown tutorial walking new users through acquiring KenPom men's college basketball data with hoopR, including configuring KP_USER/KP_PW credentials and the kp_ scraping functions.

nodes.name: markdown_man_table_helper.R
nodes.summary: Authoring helper snippets that emit column-name/type markdown tables and roxygen documentation blocks for NBA Stats data frames, easing manual @return table maintenance.

nodes.name: mbb_teams.R
nodes.summary: Short exploratory script joining NCAA men's basketball team listings with ESPN MBB teams to reconcile team-name keys across sources.

nodes.name: PR_devel.md
nodes.summary: Drafted pull-request writeup documenting a development PR's new functions, bug fixes, documentation, infrastructure changes, and testing notes for the devel branch.

nodes.name: pull_coach_links.R
nodes.summary: KenPom scraping script that logs in and parses a team page to extract coach names and profile link references, building a coaches reference table.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses rvest session_jump_to over an authenticated KenPom browser session to harvest .coach link nodes.

nodes.name: pull_nba_teams.R
nodes.summary: Data generator that pulls NBA league standings via nba_leaguestandingsv3, joins to ESPN NBA teams, and writes the bundled nba_teams dataset with usethis::use_data.

nodes.name: pull_team_links.R
nodes.summary: KenPom scraping loop spanning seasons that harvests team and conference page links per year, joins against ncaahoopR dictionaries, and persists the bundled teams_links dataset.
nodes.languageNotes: Loops years with Sys.sleep throttling and uses collapse::funique to dedupe scraped link rows.

nodes.name: pull_team_page.R
nodes.summary: Large KenPom team-page harvester defining gather_team_pages() to scrape coaches, schedules, depth charts, and player stats per team and year into bundled data frames.
nodes.languageNotes: 807-line scraper iterating every team in hoopR::teams_links and parsing multiple tables per KenPom team page.

nodes.name: sdv_author_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Small helper script that summarizes installed-package authorship/maintainer fields to support SportsDataverse author/credit tabulation.

nodes.name: selenium try.R
nodes.summary: Experimental RSelenium scratch script launching headless Chrome to render and scrape the KenPom rankings table as an alternative to the rvest session approach.

nodes.name: team_page_calls.R
nodes.summary: Driver script that sources pull_team_page.R and invokes gather_team_pages() season-by-season (most calls commented out) against an authenticated KenPom session.

nodes.name: DESCRIPTION
nodes.summary: R package manifest for hoopR 3.1.0 declaring metadata, authors, MIT license, R >= 4.1 dependency, and Imports/Suggests (httr2, dplyr, rvest, data.table, etc.) for ESPN/NBA Stats/KenPom access.

nodes.name: hoopR.Rproj
nodes.summary: RStudio project configuration for the hoopR package setting build type, devtools usage, roxygenize outputs, and two-space-tab editing conventions.

nodes.name: NAMESPACE
nodes.summary: Roxygen2-generated package namespace exporting 270+ hoopR functions (bref_, cbbd_, espn_, kp_, nba_, load_, torvik_, realgm_ families) and registering the print.hoopR_data S3 method.

nodes.name: bref_awards.R
nodes.summary: Exports bref_awards(), scraping end-of-season NBA award voting (MVP, ROY, DPOY, etc.) from Basketball-Reference into a tidy hoopR_data tibble with one row per candidate.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps scraping in tryCatch with .report_api_error/.report_api_warning and returns a make_hoopR_data tibble.

nodes.name: bref_draft.R
nodes.summary: Exports bref_draft(), scraping NBA draft results with career totals and advanced metrics from Basketball-Reference into a tidy hoopR_data tibble, one row per pick.
nodes.languageNotes: Shares the .bref_text/.bref_table/.bref_type_convert helper pattern used across the bref_ family.

nodes.name: bref_injuries.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes the current NBA injury report from Basketball-Reference and returns it as a tidy data frame via the shared bref helper layer.

nodes.name: bref_player_bios.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes player biographical information (height, weight, birth date, college, etc.) from a player's Basketball-Reference page.

nodes.name: bref_player_game_log.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes a player's per-game game log for a given season from Basketball-Reference and returns the box-score rows as a tidy frame.

nodes.name: bref_players_stats.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes season-level player statistics tables (per-game, totals, advanced, etc.) from Basketball-Reference league pages.

nodes.name: bref_standings.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes NBA conference/division standings for a season from Basketball-Reference and returns them as a tidy frame.

nodes.name: bref_team_roster.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes a team's season roster from Basketball-Reference and returns player listings as a tidy data frame.

nodes.name: bref_teams_stats.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes team-level season statistics tables (per-game, opponent, advanced) from Basketball-Reference league pages.

nodes.name: bref_utils.R
nodes.summary: Shared internal helper layer for the Basketball-Reference scrapers: .bref_text fetches a page body, .bref_table parses an HTML table, and .bref_type_convert coerces column types.
nodes.languageNotes: Internal (dot-prefixed) helpers wrap httr::GET + rvest::read_html so each endpoint scraper stays thin.

nodes.name: cbbd_api_key.R
nodes.summary: Manages the CollegeBasketballData API key (cbbd_key/has_cbbd_key/check_cbbd_key) and provides the shared authenticated .cbbd_get request helper used by every cbbd_* endpoint wrapper.
nodes.languageNotes: Key is read from the CBD_API_KEY system env var; .cbbd_get centralizes the bearer-token GET + JSON parse.

nodes.name: cbbd_conferences.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData conferences endpoints (cbbd_conferences and cbbd_conferences_history) returning conference metadata as tidy frames.

nodes.name: cbbd_draft.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData NBA-draft endpoints (cbbd_draft_teams, cbbd_draft_positions, cbbd_draft_picks) for draft-pick and prospect data.

nodes.name: cbbd_games.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData games surface (cbbd_games, cbbd_games_media, cbbd_games_teams, cbbd_games_players, cbbd_scoreboard) returning schedule, box-score, and scoreboard frames.

nodes.name: cbbd_lines.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData betting-lines endpoints (cbbd_lines and cbbd_lines_providers) returning game odds and provider metadata.

nodes.name: cbbd_lineups.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData lineup-statistics endpoints (cbbd_lineups_team and cbbd_lineups_game) returning five-man lineup metrics.

nodes.name: cbbd_plays.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData play-by-play surface (by game, player, team, date, and tournament, plus cbbd_play_types) returning detailed PBP event frames.

nodes.name: cbbd_rankings.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData poll-rankings endpoint (cbbd_rankings) returning AP and Coaches poll standings.

nodes.name: cbbd_ratings.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData team-ratings endpoints (cbbd_ratings_srs, cbbd_ratings_adjusted, cbbd_ratings_elo) returning SRS, adjusted-efficiency, and Elo ratings.

nodes.name: cbbd_recruiting.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData recruiting endpoints (cbbd_recruiting_players, cbbd_recruiting_teams, cbbd_recruiting_portal) returning prospect rankings and transfer-portal data.

nodes.name: cbbd_stats.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData statistics surface (team-season, team-leaderboard, team/player shooting, player-season) returning aggregate and shooting-split stat frames.

nodes.name: cbbd_substitutions.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData substitution endpoints (by game, player, and team) returning on/off substitution event data.

nodes.name: cbbd_teams.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData teams endpoints (cbbd_teams and cbbd_teams_roster) returning team metadata and season rosters.

nodes.name: cbbd_venues.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the CollegeBasketballData venues endpoint (cbbd_venues) returning arena/venue metadata as a tidy frame.

nodes.name: crosswalk_basketball.R
nodes.summary: Internal, deterministic normalization engine for NBA/MBB cross-source crosswalks: name/team normalizers, timezone conversion, and fuzzy matching used to reproduce cached crosswalk artifacts exactly.
nodes.languageNotes: All helpers are dot-prefixed (unexported) and deterministic so a cached loader reproduces the live builder; uses stringi/stringr for Latin-ASCII + name cleaning.

nodes.name: data.R
nodes.summary: Roxygen dataset documentation for teams_links, the men's college basketball KenPom team-link reference dictionary (357 rows, 6 variables) bundled with the package.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_athlete_career_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball helpers for career-level athlete endpoints (athlete seasons index, career statistics, and v2 event log) shared across the league-specific athlete wrappers.
nodes.languageNotes: Dot-prefixed @noRd helpers validate the league slug then build ESPN core-API requests for athletes/{id}/seasons and statistics.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_athlete_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal, cross-league ESPN basketball athlete backend: ~14 helpers (info, overview, stats, gamelog, splits, eventlog) that fetch core-v2 / site-v2 athlete resources and tidy them into tibbles, shared by both espn_nba_* and espn_mbb_* wrappers.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest helper module in the batch (1321 lines); uses many small `$ref`-resolution and JSON-extraction sub-helpers (get_bp/get_d/extract_ref).

nodes.name: espn_basketball_awards_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball season-awards helper that fetches the paginated per-season award index from the core-v2 API and returns a tidy long-format tibble of award winners.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_calendar_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball calendar helper that fetches the schedule calendar for a league and returns a tidy tibble of calendar entries/date ranges.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_coach_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball coach helper that fetches a single coach detail resource (core-v2 coaches/{coach_id}) and returns a one-row tibble of coach attributes.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_draft_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball draft backend: ~7 helpers covering draft pick detail, rounds index, draftable athletes, draft status, and the season-draft roll-up, each tidying core-v2 draft resources into tibbles.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_event_betting_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball event-odds/betting helper that fetches per-event odds-market data from the core-v2 API and returns a tidy long-format betting tibble.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_event_competitor_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball per-competitor event backend: ~8 helpers (linescores, leaders, roster, statistics, records, player box, score) that tidy a single competitor's nested event resources into tibbles.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_event_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball event-level backend: ~9 helpers (win probabilities, officials, broadcasts, situation, predictor, powerindex) that fetch and tidy nested competition resources for a single game.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_event_play_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball single-play helper wrapping events/{eid}/competitions/{cid}/plays/{pid}, returning a one-row tibble of play-by-play detail.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_franchise_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball franchise helper that fetches the core-v2 franchise resource and returns a tidy tibble of franchise metadata.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_futures_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball season-futures helper that fetches the per-season futures-market index from the core-v2 API and returns a tidy long-format tibble.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_group_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball season-groups (conference/division) helper that fetches the per-season groups index across season types and returns a tidy tibble of group hierarchy.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_injuries_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball injuries helper that fetches the league-wide injuries array and returns a tidy tibble of player injury statuses.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_league_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball league-wide backend: ~9 helpers (statistical leaders by athlete, venues, coaches, athletes index, seasons, season info) plus league-validation and $ref-parsing utilities, each tidying league-scoped API resources.
nodes.languageNotes: Carries shared validation (espn_bball_validate_league_cat) and $ref-block parsing reused across the basketball helper family.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_news_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball news helper that fetches the league-level news feed and returns a tidy tibble of articles/headlines.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_position_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball positions helper that fetches the position dictionary resource and returns a tidy reference tibble of position codes.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_powerindex_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball power-index helper that fetches the per-season BPI/powerindex resource and returns a tidy long-format tibble of team metrics.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_record_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball team-record helper that fetches the per-season-type team record resource and returns a tidy long-format tibble of W/L and category records.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_season_meta_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball season-metadata backend: ~6 helpers (season-types index/detail, season leaders, season rankings/ranking) that tidy per-season core-v2 metadata resources into tibbles.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_team_deep_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball deep-team backend: ~6 helpers (odds-records, depth chart, season roster, coach-by-season, season statistics) that tidy team-scoped per-season resources into long-format tibbles.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_team_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball team backend: ~6 helpers (team detail, roster, schedule, leaders, season profile) plus league validation, tidying site-v2 team resources into tibbles shared by NBA and MBB wrappers.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_tournaments_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball tournaments helper that fetches the league tournament index and returns a tidy tibble of tournament/bracket metadata.

nodes.name: espn_basketball_week_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Internal ESPN basketball season-weeks helper that fetches the per-season weeks index across season types and returns a tidy tibble of week boundaries.

nodes.name: espn_basketball.R
nodes.summary: Roxygen documentation landing page (@name espn_basketball) giving the cross-league ESPN Basketball endpoint overview that ties together the espn_nba_* and espn_mbb_* wrapper surfaces; contains no executable code.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_athlete_career.R
nodes.summary: Public MBB athlete-career loaders: espn_mbb_player_seasons, espn_mbb_player_career_stats, and espn_mbb_player_eventlog_v2 — exported thin wrappers that surface ESPN men's college basketball athlete career data as tibbles.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_athletes.R
nodes.summary: ESPN men's college basketball athlete endpoint wrappers (espn_mbb_player_info, _overview, _stats_v3, _gamelog, etc.), returning per-player bio, overview, V3 stats and game-log frames from ESPN's web/core athlete APIs.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_awards.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB awards wrappers (espn_mbb_season_awards, espn_mbb_award) that fetch season award lists and single-award detail from ESPN's core awards endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_calendar.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_calendar) returning the ESPN MBB season calendar of date ranges and season types for a given season.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_coach.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB coach wrappers (espn_mbb_coach, espn_mbb_coach_record) that fetch a coach's profile and win/loss record from ESPN's core coach endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_data.R
nodes.summary: Core ESPN men's college basketball data module: play-by-play, team/player box scores, game rosters, scoreboard, schedule, teams, conferences, rankings, standings, betting and team/player stats, plus the helper parsers that flatten ESPN summary payloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Large endpoint module (~3.8k lines, 17 exports) pairing public espn_mbb_* fetchers with private helper_espn_mbb_* parsers; extensive roxygen returns-tables document each output frame.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_event_detail.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB per-event (game) detail wrappers (odds, win probabilities, officials, broadcasts, and other event sub-resources) drawn from ESPN's core event endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_franchise.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB franchise wrappers (espn_mbb_franchises, espn_mbb_franchise) listing all program franchises and fetching a single franchise's detail.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_futures.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_futures) returning ESPN MBB season futures betting markets for a given season.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_groups_v2.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB v2 group/conference wrappers (espn_mbb_season_groups, espn_mbb_season_group, and children) resolving conference and grouping hierarchies for a season.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_injuries.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB injury wrappers (espn_mbb_injuries, espn_mbb_team_injuries) returning league-wide and per-team injury reports.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_league.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB league-level index wrappers (espn_mbb_leaders, espn_mbb_venues, espn_mbb_coaches, espn_mbb_athletes_index, and more) exposing season-wide leaders, venues and entity directories.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_news.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB news wrappers (espn_mbb_news, espn_mbb_team_news) returning league and team headline feeds.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_positions.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB position wrappers (espn_mbb_positions, espn_mbb_position) listing roster positions and fetching a single position's detail.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_powerindex.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_powerindex) returning ESPN's MBB power index team ratings for a season.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_season_meta.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB season metadata wrappers (espn_mbb_season_types, espn_mbb_season_type, and children) describing a season's structure, types and associated sub-resources.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_team_deep.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB deep team-resource wrappers (espn_mbb_team_odds_records, espn_mbb_team_season_roster, and more) exposing season-scoped team odds records and rosters from core team endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_team_detail.R

nodes.name: espn_mbb_team_record.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_team_record) returning a team's season win/loss record splits from ESPN's core team record endpoint.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_tournaments.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB tournament wrappers (espn_mbb_tournaments, espn_mbb_tournament, and children) listing postseason tournaments and resolving a single tournament's bracket/detail.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_weeks.R

nodes.name: espn_mbb_wp.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_wp) that extracts ESPN's per-game win-probability time series for a men's college basketball game.

nodes.name: espn_nba_athlete_career.R
nodes.summary: ESPN NBA athlete career wrappers (espn_nba_player_seasons, espn_nba_player_career_stats, and more) returning a player's season list and career statistical history.

nodes.name: espn_nba_athlete_contracts.R
nodes.summary: ESPN NBA athlete contract wrappers (espn_nba_player_contracts, espn_nba_player_contract) returning a player's contract list and single-contract detail.

nodes.name: espn_nba_athletes.R

nodes.summary: ESPN NBA awards wrappers (espn_nba_season_awards, espn_nba_award) that fetch season award lists and single-award detail; NBA mirror of espn_mbb_awards.R.

nodes.summary: Wraps the ESPN NBA calendar endpoint, returning the league's season calendar (date ranges and season types) as a tidy tibble.

nodes.summary: Fetches single-coach detail and per-coach win/loss records from ESPN's NBA Core v2 coach endpoints.

nodes.languageNotes: 19 exported per-event helper functions sharing the ESPN Core v2 event reference shape.

nodes.summary: Retrieves the ESPN NBA franchises index and single-franchise detail records (franchise identity, venue, colors) from Core v2 endpoints.

nodes.summary: Returns ESPN NBA season futures betting markets in long format from the Core v2 futures endpoint.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what hoopR is: a SportsDataverse R package that delivers tidy men's basketball data across NBA (2002-2026) and college (2006-2026) from ESPN, the NBA Stats API, the College Basketball Data API, and auxiliary sources. The landing page frames the two core access patterns the rest of the tour expands on — scraping live endpoints function-by-function, and bulk-loading pre-processed season releases. Read it first to get the map before diving into the code.

tour.title: Shared ESPN Basketball Helpers
tour.description: Before the per-league scrapers, hoopR factors the ESPN logic shared by NBA and MBB into one internal backend. espn_basketball.R is the documentation hub tying the families together, while the event, team, and athlete helper modules fetch and tidy ESPN Core v2 / Site v2 resources into tibbles that both leagues reuse. Understanding this 'one core + thin per-league wrappers' pattern is key — it explains why the next two steps look like mirror images of each other.
tour.languageLesson: R packages keep internal helpers un-exported (no @export tag) so they stay private to the package namespace. Functions prefixed with a dot (.bb_*) are an additional convention signaling 'internal, do not call directly'.

tour.title: ESPN Men's College Basketball
tour.description: espn_mbb_data.R is the heart of the MBB ESPN surface: play-by-play, team/player box scores, rosters, scoreboard, schedule, rankings, standings, and the parsers that flatten ESPN summary payloads. It leans on the shared helpers from Step 2 and is complemented by focused wrappers like deep team resources, season metadata, and the per-game win-probability extractor. This is the highest-traffic college data path in the package.

tour.title: ESPN NBA
tour.description: The NBA ESPN surface mirrors the MBB one structurally — espn_nba_data.R provides play-by-play, box scores, rosters, schedules, and standings from ESPN Site v2, while the athlete and team-detail wrappers are direct counterparts to their MBB siblings. Building on the shared helpers from Step 2, this symmetry is deliberate: the same backend serves both leagues, so once you know the MBB shape you already know the NBA shape.

tour.title: NBA Stats API
tour.description: Beyond ESPN, hoopR wraps the official stats.nba.com endpoints for richer data. nba_stats.R is the index hub; utils_nba_stats.R is the shared HTTP and result-parsing layer that builds requests (with proxy support) and maps NBA Stats resultSets into tibbles. The player module is the largest wrapper, and nba_stats_pbp.R adds enriched and live cdn.nba.com play-by-play feeds. Note the recurring pattern: a utils layer owns transport and parsing, and thin endpoint modules sit on top.

tour.title: College Basketball Data API
tour.description: The cbbd_* family wraps the third-party College Basketball Data API. cbbd_api_key.R is foundational — it manages the API key and exposes the shared authenticated .cbbd_get helper that every other cbbd_* wrapper depends on (the highest fan-in node in the whole graph). The games, lines, and stats wrappers sit on top, returning schedule/box-score, betting-odds, and aggregate-stat frames respectively.
tour.languageLesson: hoopR stores API keys in an environment variable read at request time (cbbd_key/has_cbbd_key), keeping secrets out of source and letting CI inject them via repository secrets rather than committing credentials.

tour.title: Auxiliary Sources & Web Scrapers
tour.description: hoopR also scrapes sources without clean APIs. Each family has a shared internal utils layer: bref_utils.R parses Basketball-Reference HTML tables, realgm_utils.R drives chromote page rendering for RealGM, torvik_utils.R centralizes barttorvik.com requests, and the kp_* family logs into KenPom with an httr2 cookie jar. This step shows how the same 'shared utils + thin scrapers' pattern from Steps 5-6 scales to heterogeneous HTML and authenticated sources.
tour.languageLesson: R web scraping leans on rvest (CSS/XPath HTML parsing) and httr2 (modern request pipelines with cookie-jar sessions). chromote drives a headless Chrome for JavaScript-rendered pages that rvest alone cannot read.

tour.title: Pre-Processed Data Loaders
tour.description: Scraping live endpoints is slow; for whole-season analysis hoopR ships loaders that pull pre-scraped parquet/RDS assets from SportsDataverse-data releases. load_hoopR.R is the overview hub, while load_mbb.R and load_nba.R provide season-level play-by-play, box scores, schedules, rosters, and standings with parallel download and DBI database-build helpers. These are the functions the cookbook vignettes (Step 12) actually use — the fast path most users start with.

tour.title: Utilities & Cross-Source Crosswalks
tour.description: utils.R is the package-wide backbone — KenPom credential handling, cached URL loaders, season/year helpers, team-name normalization, and the hoopR_data S3 class with its print method. data.R documents the bundled team-links reference dataset. crosswalk_basketball.R is the deterministic normalization engine that the NBA and MBB crosswalk builders use to reconcile ESPN, NBA Stats, Fox, KenPom, and Barttorvik identities into one ID map — the glue that lets data from Steps 3-8 be joined together.
tour.languageLesson: S3 is R's lightweight object system: a class is just an attribute on a value, and dispatch happens by naming a method generic.class (here print.hoopR_data). It needs no formal class declaration — the print method is registered in NAMESPACE.

tour.title: Package Manifest & Namespace
tour.description: Two generated/authored config files define hoopR as an installable R package. DESCRIPTION is the manifest: version 3.1.0, MIT license, R >= 4.1, and the Imports/Suggests (httr2, dplyr, rvest, data.table) that power every layer you have seen. NAMESPACE is roxygen2-generated and exports the 270+ functions across the bref_/cbbd_/espn_/kp_/nba_/load_/torvik_/realgm_ families plus the print.hoopR_data S3 method, controlling exactly what users can call.
tour.languageLesson: In R packages DESCRIPTION declares dependencies and metadata, while NAMESPACE — regenerated from roxygen2 @export/@importFrom tags, never hand-edited — governs which functions are public and which packages' symbols are imported.

tour.title: Worked Examples: Vignettes
tour.description: Vignettes are hoopR's runnable tutorials and the best end-to-end view of how the layers combine. getting-started walks installation and a quick-start; the MBB and NBA cookbooks stitch loaders (Step 8), ESPN data (Steps 3-4), NBA Stats (Step 5), and KenPom metrics (Step 7) into real analysis workflows. The ESPN-endpoints, CBBD, and KenPom vignettes document those specific surfaces by use case. Read these to see the package used the way an analyst would.

tour.title: CI/CD & Docs Pipeline
tour.description: Finally, the automation that keeps hoopR healthy. R-CMD-check.yaml runs R CMD check across a macOS/Windows/Ubuntu matrix on push, PR, and a weekly cron, with opt-in live-API test toggles supplied via secrets. pkgdown.yaml builds and deploys the documentation site (configured by _pkgdown.yml, which groups the reference index by data-source family), and rhub.yaml fans out cross-platform checks for CRAN submission. Together they enforce that every layer in this tour stays installable and documented.
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions workflows use 'on' triggers (push/pull_request/schedule), a matrix to test across OS/R-version combinations in parallel, and repository secrets to inject API credentials so live-API tests run without committing keys.
